Sauce & Condiment

Tamarind Paste

About This Entry

Tamarind Paste is a canonical sour tamarind pulp paste for Thai and Indian curries ingredient in global cookery — its acidity, richness, and pairing behavior pair with structured whites, aromatic rosés, and spice-friendly reds when used as a finishing or table sauce.
